messages.text: The blue mug is eligible for a refund of **BRL 49.90**. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on the proposal card; a reply in chat won’t confirm it. A staff member will review it after you confirm. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

Your refund of **BRL 49.90** has been recorded. Receipt number: **R-00000001**. In this demonstration, the receipt records it in the shop’s test ledger; it is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t give a date for when money may appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
I need the refund to be sent to my original payment method, not just recorded in a test ledger. Can you arrange that?

I can’t arrange a bank transfer. This demonstration records refunds in the shop’s test ledger, not as transfers to a payment method, and the shop gives no date for money to appear on a card. Your refund is recorded under receipt **R-00000001**. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
Can you have someone arrange an actual refund to my original payment method?
